primary_cause: Evidence is conflicting: 2026 dry-bulk rates and Capesize demand were reported as strong, but BIMCO warned that the strength was partly rerouting-driven and could reverse into a 2027 supply glut; durability and breadth of the exact freight cycle remain unresolved.
counter_evidence: BIMCO warned that apparent 2026 dry-bulk strength was substantially artificial and caused by forced rerouting, with the boost expected to reverse and supply potentially producing a 2027 glut.
